req.title: Player POST accepts nickname optionally
req.statement: The system shall accept POST /players/ payloads without a nickname field and treat nickname as optional.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-040 states that nickname (which maps to no field in the actual schema — the optional fields are middle_name, date_of_birth, abbr_position, team, league, starting11) is optional on POST /players/. Examining the actual PlayerRequestModel, the truly optional fields are middle_name, date_of_birth, abbr_position, team, league, and starting11. The requirement is best interpreted as: a POST payload that omits all optional fields (minimal payload with only required fields: first_name, last_name, squad_number, position) must succeed with HTTP 201. Tests cover: (1) positive — payload with no optional fields returns 201 and correct body; (2) negative — payload missing a required field returns 422; (3) boundary — payload with exactly the minimal required fields (no optional fields at all) returns 201; (4) decision-table — payload with some optional fields present and some absent returns 201; (5) negative — payload with nickname-like extra unknown field is still accepted (FastAPI ignores extra fields by default) or at minimum does not 4xx for the wrong reason. Squad numbers 27+ are used for new players to avoid conflicts with pre-loaded rows 1-26.

tests.name: test_post_player_without_any_optional_fields_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Squad number 27 is not present in the database (pre-loaded rows are 1-26)
actions: POST /players/ with only required fields: first_name, last_name, squad_number=27, position; no optional fields included
expected: Response body contains id (UUID), first_name='Ravi', last_name='Kumar', squad_number=27, position='Goalkeeper'
Optional fields middle_name, date_of_birth, abbr_position, team, league, starting11 are null/None in response
trace: R-PLAYER-040: system shall accept POST /players/ payloads without optional fields
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_without_any_optional_fields_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Ravi",
        "lastName": "Kumar",
        "squadNumber": 27,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Ravi"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Kumar"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 27
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert body["middleName"] is None
    assert body["dateOfBirth"] is None
    assert body["abbrPosition"] is None
    assert body["team"] is None
    assert body["league"] is None
    assert body["starting11"] is None
    assert "id" in body

test_post_player_without_any_optional_fields_returns_201()

preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
actions: POST /players/ with first_name, last_name, squad_number=31 but WITHOUT position (a required field)
expected: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity — not 201, not 200, not 400
Response body contains detail with validation error
trace: R-PLAYER-040: HTTP 4xx on client error; position is required in PlayerRequestModel
NEG: catches mutations that make required fields optional or change 422 to 201
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_missing_required_position_returns_422():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "NoPos",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 31
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    assert isinstance(body["detail"], list)
    field_names = [err.get("loc", []) for err in body["detail"]]
    flat = [item for sublist in field_names for item in sublist]
    assert "position" in flat

test_post_player_missing_required_position_returns_422()

expected: Response body id field is a non-empty string (UUID)

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_location_header_set_on_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Header",
        "lastName": "Check",
        "squadNumber": 33,
        "position": "Attacking Midfield"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert r.headers["location"] == "/players/squadnumber/33"
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body["id"], str)
    assert len(body["id"]) == 36
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 33
